sounds.name: pop
sounds.label: Pop
sounds.description: A short bright blip that drops in pitch. The default: it reads on a phone speaker without covering the voice.

sounds.name: click
sounds.label: Click
sounds.description: A tick, barely there. For a look where every word fires and anything longer would turn into a drum solo.

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.label: Whoosh
sounds.description: Filtered noise that swells and goes. The transition sound; best on a look where captions arrive a line at a time.

sounds.name: impact
sounds.label: Impact
sounds.description: A low thump with a transient on the front. Reserve it for keywords; on every sentence it becomes exhausting.

sounds.name: riser
sounds.label: Riser
sounds.description: A tone that climbs. It points at the word after it, so it belongs on the last line before a punchline, not everywhere.
